title: Make billsplit's APK buildable and stop the CI mirror fighting a dirty tree
objective: billsplit had never produced an Android APK: file_picker 11.0.3, the latest release, cannot compile under AGP 9 in either built-in-Kotlin mode. Replace it with the official file_selector so the app builds, verify the launcher icon from the built artifact rather than from a preview, keep the build inside this machine's 2 GB memory budget, and make the pre-push CI mirror stop failing whenever the shared checkout has uncommitted work.
acceptance_criteria: The launcher icon extracted from the APK is the charcoal + gold perforated-receipt glyph and does not match the stock Flutter beach icon
Peak PSS across the build's JVM and Dart processes stays under 2 GiB, measured from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup
flutter analyze is clean, all tests pass, and billsplit holds 100% line coverage with no coverage ignores
meta/scripts/ci_mirror.sh passes while the working tree is dirty, leaves every uncommitted file byte-identical, and removes its temporary worktree
billsplit's Gradle and AGP versions stay identical to the sibling Flutter apps
out_of_scope: Pinning AGP 8 or otherwise diverging billsplit's Android toolchain from habit_stack, home_inventory, todo and diet_guard_app
Installing or running the APK on the phone; the icon is verified from the artifact, not from a device launcher
Any change to the split engine, xlsx export format, or e-paragon parsing
Upgrading the other dependencies pub reports as outdated
verifier: flutter analyze, flutter test --no-pub --coverage and python3 -m python_pkg.billsplit_coverage inside billsplit; flutter build apk --debug followed by unzipping the APK and rendering its ic_launcher assets; a PSS sampler over the build's processes; bash meta/scripts/ci_mirror.sh run deliberately against a dirty tree with before/after md5 of an uncommitted file; shellcheck on the rewritten script; and pre-commit run --files on the staged set inside a 2G cgroup
